title: Flydubai's Captain Breaks His Silence, American Starlink Goes All-In, and Southwest's Bag Fee Lawsuit Gets Dodged
summary: The flydubai captain who survived a mid-air stabbing describes fighting to open a bulletproof cockpit door with 184 lives on the line. Plus, American may be about to out-wifi Delta on every single plane, United keeps chipping away at what "first class" even means, Southwest wiggles out of a bag fee lawsuit with a very convenient new rule, and Thai Airways learns the hard way that lost luggage can cost you your job.
